{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data types and missing values
print(trial_df.info())

# Check for duplicates
print(f"Number of duplicate rows: {trial_df.duplicated().sum()}")

# Check unique values in key columns
print(f"Unique arms: {trial_df['arm'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique severities: {trial_df['severity'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique sites: {trial_df['site'].unique()}")

# Check distribution of 'responded'
print(f"Distribution of responded: {trial_df['responded'].value_counts(normalize=True)}")"}
